snippet.title: Bubbler - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Please Play Bubbler On Steam now, It's only 1$

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542490/Bubbler/

Bubble up in Bubbler, the bubbliest farming game of your dreams as you unbubble the wondrous world of The Bubbles. Gamble your earnings for bubbly accessories, buy your very own bubble pets and upgrade your skills as you expand your farm.
